terra.problem: The text says the five kings came as allies, but it does not say whether anyone dragged them there in chains.
The sticky-cookie joke compares a minor mishap to men falling into tar pits during a battle, making light of their danger.
The text says Lot was living in Sodom when he was carried off. It does not say he was in the valley.
The text says Abram divided his forces, but it does not say he split them into two groups.
“Nothing left behind” goes beyond the text. It says Abram retrieved all the goods and the people named, not that nothing at all was left behind.
“Everything the four kings took came home” goes beyond the text. It says Abram retrieved all the goods and the people named.
Calling the bread and wine a welcome for Abram states a purpose the text does not give.
The text does not say this happened in the afternoon.
The text says Abram allows the men who went with him to take their portion, not that they actually receive it. It also does not say Abram kept what his men had eaten for himself.
